description: Physical coldness that radiates from him — nipped nose, shrivelled cheek, red eyes, thin blue lips, stiffened gait, frosty rime on head and brows
Heated and flushed from rapid walking through fog and frost; ruddy face, sparkling eyes, visible breath
Scrooge has buttoned his great-coat to the chin in preparation for going out into the cold
Cratchit has no great-coat, only a white comforter with long dangling ends, leaving him less protected against the cold
Has a cold in his head (gruel and saucepan prepared on the hob)
Changed out of street clothes into dressing-gown and slippers
Wearing nightcap as part of settled-in-for-evening dress
Fell to his knees before the Ghost in terror after the jaw-drop revelation
Went to bed without undressing, asleep instantly
Ghost of Christmas Past has clasped Scrooge gently but irresistibly by the arm and is leading him toward the window
Scrooge is openly sobbing, triggered by sight of his neglected childhood self
Scrooge puts his hand in his pocket, reaching instinctively for money to give the carol-singing boy he now regrets dismissing
Ghost has seized both arms and physically forces Scrooge to watch; he cannot turn away or move freely
Overcome by irresistible drowsiness after wrestling with the Ghost and pressing down the extinguisher-cap
Reeled to bed and sank into heavy sleep in his own bedroom
Has risen from bed and is moving on foot toward the adjoining room in his slippers
Scrooge has taken hold of the Ghost of Christmas Present's robe at the Spirit's instruction
Carried Tiny Tim on his shoulder from church
Uses a crutch and has limbs supported by an iron frame
Wearing at least three feet of comforter hanging down before him
Legs trembling, barely able to stand when preparing to follow the Phantom
Scrooge seizes the Ghost's hand and detains it in desperate entreaty before the figure collapses into his bedpost
Face wet with tears from sobbing during the conflict with the Spirit
Has scrambled into day clothes (put on inside out, upside down, in disarray) replacing dressing gown and nightcap
Hand shaking persistently, making writing and shaving difficult
Changed from street clothes into his best attire for going out
